responsibility: Is the main machine description for the 32-bit Arm backend. It defines core register numbers, instruction attributes, RTL patterns and expands for Arm and Thumb instructions, coprocessor and security instructions, speculation barriers, PAC/BTI-related insns, and includes the subsidiary .md files for VFP, Thumb, NEON, crypto, sync, fixed-point, and MVE so that GCC can recognize, generate, and schedule Arm RTL instructions.
same_name_distinction: Supplies the declarative RTL machine description for Arm instructions, attributes, and included sub-pattern files; unlike arm.cc it is not C++ hook code, unlike arm.h it is not a target configuration header, and unlike arm.opt it does not define command-line options.
